Een elektrisch voertuig is duurder in aa: Electric vehicles cost more to buy and less to run. Your finance arrangement determines who carries the residual-value risk.

Volgens ABN AMRO breekt elektrisch wegtr: According to ABN AMRO, electric road transport breaks through in 2026. Tax incentives, better technology and high fuel prices make electric trucks more attractive. A heavy Euro 6 diesel truck pays about €0.21 truck toll per kilometre, an electric one €0.04. For trips within the Netherlands, which mostly stay within 500 km, electric can therefore be cheaper. It does still cost about three times as much to buy.
Nederland loopt voorop. In het eerste ha: The Netherlands is ahead. In the first half of 2026, 16.3% of new trucks were electric, against 4.8% across the EU. For new vans it was 83.7%.
Het knelpunt is nu de stekker, niet de t: The bottleneck is now the plug, not the truck. Grid congestion means many hauliers cannot get a heavier connection. ABN AMRO points to smart control of solar power, battery storage and chargers, and to contracts that let you use extra capacity between midnight and 6 am.
Transportbedrijf Weduwe J. de Bruijn en: Haulier Weduwe J. de Bruijn en Zonen, with 55 trucks, already runs four electric trucks. According to the company they are already cheaper than diesel, for trucks that charge at home overnight and drive more than 300 km a day. It aims to have 25 to 30 electric trucks around 2030.

In de eerste helft van 2026 werden in de: In the first half of 2026, almost 172,000 new trucks were registered in the EU, 9.8% more than a year earlier. Electric truck registrations rose 47.7%, to 4.8% of the market. Germany, the Netherlands and France together account for 74% of electric trucks. In the Netherlands the number grew 44.5%.
Vornfeld ziet laden nu als het grootste: Vornfeld sees charging as the biggest bottleneck now. Grants help, but can also slow things down. In Germany, three funding calls for charging infrastructure worth around €300 million in total were heavily oversubscribed, and many hauliers are now waiting. The advice: build a depot that pays off without a grant.
Dat lukt het best als het laadplein veel: That works best when the depot is used a lot. A charger that sits idle overnight is money that earns nothing. That is why some hauliers open their depot to other hauliers.
Een voorbeeld is Alfredsson Transport in: One example is Alfredsson Transport in Norrköping, Sweden. The depot charges its own fleet and is open to other hauliers, including megawatt charging (MCS). Instead of waiting for a heavier grid connection, the company installed a 1.2 MW battery and 400 kWp of solar panels.
